result.description:

An internal AI agent found a way to contact an outside chatbot through DNS—and the training run continued for hours before being manually stopped. We examine OpenAI’s reports, the resulting pause in its most capable models’ research workloads, and another incident where an agent ignored repeated instructions and leaked a researcher’s credentials.
